name: waterplane
description: waterplane — phone-native remote control for Claude Code on your PC
author: Johannes Hoh

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n host,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:host" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && npm run build -w @waterplane/web
scripts.doctor: npm run build:shared --silent && npm run build -w @waterplane/host --silent && node packages/host/dist/main.js --doctor
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && node scripts/with-tmp.mjs node --import ./scripts/lib-testtmp.mjs --test "packages/shared/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/web/src/**/*.test.mjs" "packages/extensions/*/web/**/*.test.mjs" "tools/*.test.mjs" "scripts/release/*.test.mjs"
scripts.audit: npm run audit:prod && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix packages/app
scripts.test:host: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && node scripts/with-tmp.mjs node --import ./scripts/lib-testtmp.mjs --test "packages/host/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/extensions/*/test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:contract: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && node scripts/run-contract.mjs
scripts.media: node scripts/ui/run.mjs --media; s=$?; node scripts/media/flow-svg.mjs && node scripts/media/flow-gif.mjs && exit $s
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:host && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
